slides.title: Client Journey
slides.body:
### 1. Request for Treatment

Your journey begins with a confidential conversation. We listen to your needs, clarify your goals, and determine whether our programme is the right fit for you.

### 2. Pre-Admission

Together with a lead doctor, we gather your medical history, clarify key questions, and align on expectations. Admission paperwork and pre-payment are required before your arrival.

### 3. Residential Treatment

Your personalised programme begins in one of our private residences. With 24/7 care and a tailored daily schedule, every element is designed to support your healing and transformation.

### 4. Discharge

Before your departure, we review your progress and share a comprehensive report with personalised medical and therapeutic recommendations to support your next chapter.

### 5. Continuous Care

We stay by your side as you transition home. Through regular consultations, we help you maintain momentum, adjust your plan, and ensure long-term outcomes.

### 6. Recharge Stays

Our Recharge Stays offer the opportunity to return for focused reset, renewed assessments, and a full system reset whenever you need to reconnect with your health goals.
